verdict.rationale: Exa documents asynchronous job products. Exa Agent is described as an async API for high-compute list building, enrichment and deep research, and Websets results arrive asynchronously through the API or webhooks. However, nothing shows a batch endpoint for submitting large volumes of ordinary search queries, so the high-volume query side of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented batch submission API for bulk search/contents queries, job status/polling semantics, throughput limits for async jobs, and independent hands-on corroboration of high-volume async use.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can submit batched or asynchronous jobs for high-volume query workloads

citations.quote: Exa Agent is an async, usage-based web research agent API for high-compute tasks like list building, enrichment, and deep research.
Results arrive asynchronously through the dashboard, API, or webhooks.
Async deep research, list building, and enrichment.
Get real-time HTTP callbacks as items are added or enriched
